inputs.text: [excited] He was 9 meters long — as long as a truck. 2 meters tall — as tall as a front door. And 4,000 kilos — [amazed] as heavy as 2 rhinos.
[gasps] As tall as a front door, plus a helmet?
[confident] Yes. A big duck-billed herbivore, [proud] with his crest right on top of his skull.
